reply_text:
@Bettina Kroll, I couldn't set up the weekly digest. The scheduler refused the job with a gateway credentials error (`gateway cron.add requires credentials`), so nothing is scheduled and nothing has been posted. Someone with gateway admin access needs to fix the scheduler's auth config, then I can create the job. Once it's in place, it will:

- Run every Monday at 08:00 America/Chicago, starting Monday 19 October 2026.
- Post a "Coastal week ahead" message here in #coastal-team, covering the previous week in #coastal-team and #coastal-random plus open customer items.
- Leave out finance figures (rates, prices, discounts, contract values, invoice amounts, payment terms) and finance documents, since this channel isn't limited to the account owner and finance people. Seat counts, renewal dates, licensed products, ticket numbers and contacts can still go in.
- Skip direct messages.
